Q1: The default branch already has the fix, so which branch should this issue change?
Choices:
A) None. Close this issue as already done; PR #6976 picks up the fix when it syncs or merges the default branch, and nothing new is committed. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Make the test change on PR #6976's head branch `ai/issue-6969`, by adding `Integration branch: ai/issue-6969` to this issue, so the fix lands directly on the failing PR.
C) Run implement on the default branch anyway. Expect a no-op implementation that the pipeline closes as already done.
